svg.title: Maknae tool invocation
svg.desc: UML sequence diagram of one tool invocation by either front end, each step marked live, unreachable, decided or planned: the catalog, the kernel's decision, the reach check, the workspace mount, the credential mint and relay, the container launch, the per-connection proxy decision, redaction and release to the model.
svg.text: One tool call: who decides, who runs it, where the credential comes from, what the model sees
The same steps for a person's maknae and for maknae-agentd working a task. A task changes only the inputs: the uid, the workspace, bindings and reach, the credential.
Each step is marked with its build state. Today a model is offered only the six file tools and task_agent, so no gh, git or cargo call is made; the decision core has no caller until #479.
5. «unreachable» resolve and render; a slot or argv refusal stops before the PDP
6. «unreachable» decide tool.invoke: containment, tools.yaml ceiling, role, Tool(...) grants
7. «#168» the shape's forge needs must lie within the task's reach
8. «unreachable» decide the workspace mount; denies become the mask set
permission set the task does not
hold yet, or one near expiry
21. «#479» redact every credential value it delivered
«live» built, reachable in production · «unreachable» built, no production caller · «decided» in an ADR, not built · «#N» planned in that issue
maknae-agentd refetches when a TaskClaim reply's digest changes; maknae fetches on demand (maknae tools). The catalog is a hint and never authority.
Today the model is offered the six file tools and task_agent only; any other tool name is answered 'unknown tool' by the front end.
A person cites no task, so no bindings or reach; an agent cites its task. Bindings on session.new for a person's own session are #479.
tool.invoke is not grantable to any role until #479. In a task, an entry whose credential kind has no reach check is refused.
The tool-call path (unreachable) stamps reach.git.base and reach.git.head on the request; nothing reads them. #168 PR C adds the refusal.
Person: current or path, never home or above, the personal sensitive.yaml added. Agent: the task's own directory, the host list only (per-task layout #476).
Built and tested, sent by no verb until #479. A front end that cannot carry out an obligation denies. The per-invocation proxy identity joins the obligation with #566.

Agent in a task: the class's minted token (below), or for a machine-user kind its own stored token, which the front end delivers (ADR-0038 decision 2). Person: the person's own credential (ADR-0037 decision 6).
Maintainer, 2026-11-25: minted at the first launch that needs the set, not at claim. How the kernel's wait is bounded is open (D6).
The kernel cannot open either blob. It stores for_revocation with the task, for the revoke when the task ends (#168 PR C; task D4, ruled; generated-task-tool-lifecycle.svg).
Only a test renderer exists. maknae-agentd cannot launch containers until its unit and SELinux confinement change (ADR-0036 decision 19).
The container's only route: an internal Podman network and a relay in the rootless network namespace (measured 2026-11-18).
Content-blind: the proxy sees host and port only, so classification checks do not run on tool traffic (ADR-0036 decision 9, owed to a later ADR).
redacted by default, status_only for entries that read secrets. Redaction prevents accident; it does not stop workspace code that holds the credential.
Task tokens live for the task: re-minted before expiry and revoked when the task ends (task D3 and D4, ruled; generated-task-tool-lifecycle.svg). A Vault child token is revoked per invocation.
The release is a kernel decision. The transport is live for file-tool results; category detection is not built, so tool output counts as unmarked.
Open decisions, each with a recommendation for the maintainer's ruling

D1 (step 6). ADR-0036's Built and Owed lists predate #674 PR 3a. Grammars, shapes (in place of tool-aware deny_args matching) and binds: are parsed in production and served by tool.catalog, and binds: also

selects the agent's forge credentials for the reach check at intake, but no call is decided on them until #479; the tool-call decision, the obligations with the mask set and the Podman renderer are built and
reached from tests only. Recommendation: add a dated as-built status line to ADR-0036's Consequences.
D2 (step 8). Does the front end mount the workspace noexec when the entry does not run workspace code (ADR-0036 decision 6 leaves it to #479)? Recommendation: yes, with executes_workspace carried in
tool.launch so the front end never reads tools.yaml.

D3 (step 9). ADR-0035's Consequences still list the obligation wire field and the forward class as owed; both are built (#674 PR 3a, discharge_for_tool_call). Recommendation: add a dated as-built status line

D4 (step 10). How does a person's own credential reach a tool container? ADR-0037 decision 6 says the person's own credential, and tools.yaml has no credential source for it. Recommendation: a subject
source, read by the front end with the person's own Vault login from the token maknae forge login stores, so both callers deliver through credential classes.

D5 (step 11). ADR-0036 decision 13 and ADR-0037 decision 7 say the token is minted at hand-out, ADR-0038's Consequences owe 'the kernel's call at task claim', and #168's close-out scope item 2 says at

TaskClaim, lazily per permission set; the maintainer ruled 2026-11-25 to mint lazily at the first launch that needs the set. Recommendation: amend all three ADRs and the #168 banner in #168 PR C, when the

D6 (step 11). The kernel's deadline on a Mint frame (ADR-0038 residual 2): close the egress socket when it passes, or size it to the 1280 s worst case? Recommendation: close the socket, so a late reply's
write fails and egress revokes; a lazy mint asks for one set, whose worst case is 160 s (140 s plus its revoke) rather than 1280 s.
D7 (step 12). ADR-0037 decision 7 still says one token or one per set stays open; ADR-0038 decision 3 and the code mint one per set. Recommendation: amend ADR-0037 decision 7 to record it settled.
D8 (step 15). How may maknae-agentd launch containers: drop NoNewPrivileges from its unit, or a launch helper outside its process tree that runs as the agent's uid and starts only what an obligation
describes (ADR-0036 decision 19)? Recommendation: the launch helper, so the daemon keeps NoNewPrivileges and its SELinux domain stays narrow.

D9 (step 15). #168's acceptance item that the gh tool container holds no token was superseded by ADR-0036 decision 13 (the container gets a narrowed token). Recommendation: strike it in #168 with a dated

D10 (step 16). #168's destinations: item (a GitHub destination class in authz.yaml): ADR-0039 decision 6 leaves per-role forge grants unbuilt because reach already bounds a task, and the proxy decides each
CONNECT by site. Recommendation: strike it in #168 as superseded, with a dated note when PR C lands.
D11 (step 19). Classification checks on tool traffic (ADR-0022 decision 6) are owed to a later ADR (ADR-0036 decision 9). Recommendation: no ruling now; take it up with the disclosure model, #147.
